nodes.name: West Carriage Porch
nodes.visual_signature: Pointed Gothic arched carriage porch on the western facade, gate piers crowned by the carved stone lion and tiger, ornamental wrought iron gates folded back against the buff sandstone

nodes.name: West Vestibule
nodes.visual_signature: Short vaulted vestibule in polished Kurla stone, clustered columns with carved foliate capitals either side, doorway ahead opening into the domed central hall

nodes.name: Central Dome Hall
nodes.visual_signature: Octagonal ribbed dome overhead with alternating bands of buff and blue stone, tall stained glass lancet windows, open floor with the grand staircase rising to the north

nodes.name: Grand Staircase
nodes.visual_signature: Broad stone staircase splitting at a half landing, ornate wrought iron balustrade with brass handrail, carved newel posts, stained glass window on the landing wall

nodes.name: Booking Hall
nodes.visual_signature: High ribbed vaulted ceiling with timber ribs, large stained glass windows in reds and blues, star patterned polished stone floor, ticket counters in carved teak along the far wall

nodes.name: North Administration Wing
nodes.visual_signature: Range of office doors in dark teak with brass numerals along one side, arcaded windows opposite looking onto the street, worn stone floor with a central runner

nodes.name: South Administration Wing
nodes.visual_signature: Office range mirroring the north wing, glazed partition screens above waist height, ceiling fans on long down rods, noticeboard with railway circulars beside the entry

nodes.name: North Gallery
nodes.visual_signature: Long arcaded gallery with a run of pointed arches on carved columns, open to the courtyard on one side, framed archive photographs of the station along the inner wall

nodes.name: East Spine Corridor
nodes.visual_signature: Straight corridor running east from the dome hall toward the concourse, cast iron columns at intervals, daylight increasing toward the far end where the train shed begins

nodes.name: Railway Heritage Gallery
nodes.visual_signature: Museum room with glass display cases on cast iron legs, brass signalling instruments and old timetables mounted on the walls, a large scale locomotive model on a plinth at the centre

nodes.name: Heritage Lift
nodes.visual_signature: Retrofitted lift in a glazed shaft set into the old fabric, brushed steel doors with a modern call panel mounted on a stone reveal, small blue accessibility pictogram beside it

nodes.name: Main Line Concourse
nodes.visual_signature: Wide open concourse under an iron and glass roof, riveted lattice girders overhead, departure board suspended at the centre, crowd barriers funnelling toward the platform gates

nodes.name: Platform 1
nodes.visual_signature: Long platform under the ridge and furrow train shed, cast iron columns with decorative brackets carrying the roof, yellow safety line along the platform edge, numbered pillar signs

nodes.name: Platform 2
nodes.visual_signature: Second platform sharing the shed, benches in cast iron and timber along the centre line, overhead indicator boards at intervals, water booth near the concourse end

nodes.name: Grand Staircase (Upper)
nodes.visual_signature: Upper flight of the same stone staircase arriving at a balustraded landing, ornate iron scrollwork at the head of the stairs, tall stained glass window filling the wall opposite

nodes.name: Dome Gallery
nodes.visual_signature: Gallery running around the open well of the dome, carved stone balustrade looking down into the hall below, ribbed underside of the dome directly overhead with painted bosses

nodes.name: Upper North Gallery
nodes.visual_signature: Arcaded upper corridor mirroring the gallery below, pointed arches glazed against the weather, framed engineering drawings of the terminus hung between the piers

nodes.name: Upper East Gallery
nodes.visual_signature: Upper corridor running east above the spine, timber floor with a worn central strip, doors to the senior offices on one side and tall windows onto the train shed on the other

nodes.name: General Manager's Office
nodes.visual_signature: Panelled door in polished teak with a brass nameplate, heavy moulded architrave, carpeted anteroom visible inside with a long table and a marble fireplace on the far wall

nodes.name: Board Room
nodes.visual_signature: Large room with a single long polished table down the centre, portraits of former chief engineers in gilt frames, pendant lights on long chains from a coffered ceiling

nodes.name: Drawing Office
nodes.visual_signature: Long top-lit room with rows of sloped drafting tables, plan chests in dark wood along the walls, rolled drawings stacked in pigeonholes near the door

nodes.name: Record Room
nodes.visual_signature: Archive room lined floor to ceiling with steel shelving, bound ledgers and linen backed plans in labelled bundles, single caged bulb and a rolling ladder on a rail

nodes.name: Heritage Lift (Upper)
nodes.visual_signature: Upper landing of the retrofitted lift, same brushed steel doors set into a stone reveal, call panel with the floor indicator above, accessibility pictogram beside the frame

equipment.name: Automatic Ticket Vending Machine 3
equipment.visual_signature: free standing steel kiosk with a blue fascia and a small touchscreen, coin slot and smart card reader below, queue rail in front
equipment.manual_snippet: Accepts smart cards and coins only. For season tickets use the staffed counter. If the screen is unresponsive, report the kiosk number to the counter supervisor - do not strike the panel.

equipment.name: Heritage Locomotive Model
equipment.visual_signature: large scale black and brass steam locomotive model on a raised timber plinth under a glass hood, brass nameplate on the plinth face
equipment.manual_snippet: Display only - do not open the hood. Cleaning is scheduled quarterly by the conservation team. Report any condensation inside the glass to the gallery curator immediately.

equipment.name: Main Departure Board
equipment.visual_signature: wide suspended display board hung from the shed girders above the centre of the concourse, amber characters on a dark ground, twin panels for main line and suburban services
equipment.manual_snippet: Feed comes from the control office; do not reset locally. If a panel blanks, log the fault reference and call control on the internal line before the next departure window.

equipment.name: Plan Chest 4
equipment.visual_signature: wide shallow drawer cabinet in dark wood against the wall, brass drawer pulls and card label holders, drawing board resting on top
equipment.manual_snippet: Drawers hold linen backed originals - handle with the cotton gloves kept on top. Do not remove a sheet from the room. Log any withdrawal in the register with your staff number.
